g1_recovery_definition: erratum G1-E1: 20% drawdown from running peak; recovery=close returns to dd-start peak; <=3
g1_quantile_order: erratum v2 G1-P1: pool-level 99.5% quantile computed ONCE on FULL episode population (pre-filter), then recovery filter; INSUFFICIENT_CANDIDATES registered when <20, no backfill
g2_reference_high: erratum v2 G2-P1+P1b: reference = pre-20d max close EXCLUDING T0; check window = T0+1..T0+120 (excl. T0); no-new-high = max(close[T0+1..T0+120]) <= pre20 high
g4_authoritative_rule: erratum G4-E1: anchor_generation detailed rule; group-rule phrase is shorthand; gain_12m only for uniqueness

universe.erratum: CSR-7 text said 5,241; frozen source says 5,240 (UNI-E1)

data_window.caveat: 研究窗 2021 起（本地资产边界）；G1 窗口 18-60 月可行；G3/G4 右删失排除如实登记；G2 事件表覆盖 2024-01..2026-09；G5 provisional（现时行业快照，G5-E1：Phase B PIT 行业表落地后 revalidation+同规则整体重放）

sampling.algorithm: single seeded rng flow; random 20; if single-year>50% then seeded stratified RANDOM redraw (bucket shuffle, not metric top-N); remainder by global metric desc; <=1 redraw (erratum SAM-E1)
sampling.conservation: chosen/substitutes/excluded pairwise disjoint, union=candidates (script gate, erratum SAM-E2)

rules_implemented: G1 calendar-month-start rolling window best-gain per stock (375..1250d); recovery<=3 (20% machine); pool 99.5% quantile threshold on filtered set
G2 T3 frozen events (canonicalized at ingest); <breakout close & no new high vs prior 20d; severity=max dd; per-stock severity max tie earliest
G3 ret252 cross-sec pct>=90; anchor=fwd 180d peak; dd>=60%; per-stock dd max tie earliest
G4 vol60 ann. pct<=20 & turn60 pct<=30 run>=504d; launch=first ret20 pct>=85 within 252d; episode needs launch+252; uniqueness by gain_12m desc (G4-E1)
G5 industry equal-weight (hfq-derived, snapshot caveat, provisional G5-E1); r120 >= own-history 95pct (sampling rule, not realtime); consecutive merge; member 40-60 pct; ind strength tie earliest
